summary: Candidate is a distinct session_skill for LLM provider integration within the AgentOps framework. It does not semantically overlap with peer candidates (session initialization, client initialization, decorator factory) or existing skills (Flink StreamExecutionEnvironment, ProcessPoolExecutor). The candidate addresses a specific capability: establishing a reusable provider class pattern with BaseProvider inheritance, event tracking, and method override/undo mechanics. Support evidence from Debugging Roadmap confirms the pattern. No merge, split, or revision relationship exists with other skills.
